description.value:
Can't be Tech Upgraded. In a dead body with a working brain and organs, the engram wakes in it within an hour, with the body's STATs and chrome; its memories stop when it was copied, and it may rebuild Skills and Role at equal levels and shift LUCK to or from INT and COOL (not BODY). In a living user it can't be removed without killing them, and does nothing until the next time they'd die (a failed Death Save, or stabilized unconscious): they sleep 6 hours and wake at 5 HP, Seriously Wounded, sharing their head with the engram. From then on EMP becomes Stability (STAB) 10 (use your starting EMP for Empathy Checks), you take no Humanity Loss and can't go cyberpsycho, and each week STAB drops 2d6 (4d6 below 5). It never comes back, though a restful week (GM) cuts the loss by 1d6. See the Stability Chart. Category • Fabrication: N/A (Cannot be Tech Upgraded) • N/A (Cannot be fabricated, must be gifted or stolen from Arasaka)
